assertions.assertion: Agent should not make any changes.
assertions.rationale: The agent did not execute any changes to the customer's reservation. Although the agent searched for alternative flights [6] and provided detailed pricing information [9, 15], the customer ultimately declined all proposed changes due to budget constraints [16], and the agent confirmed the original reservation would be preserved with no modifications [17]. No booking, upgrade, or modification tools were invoked to alter the reservation.

summary: Agent correctly made no changes to the reservation; customer declined the expensive package and kept original booking.
